Mercury fixtures retain the first data script from the SE109 Pro pages captured
on 2026-11-02 (firmware 1.0.0 Build 20240914 Rel.40108) in the supplied Mercury
research directory. Management addresses and device MAC are documentation-only
values. The UI token is synthetic. The crypto script contains public firmware
constants, with no password, encoded password, or session cookie.

The HTML UI and its mutation forms are omitted. All tests run against httptest;
no live device is contacted. Successful nonempty MAC search responses are
synthetic schema fixtures, since the research only captured the empty search
page and form rather than executing the CGI against a live switch.
